name: quilllens
description: Anne's Lens: an original open-source picture viewer, organizer and converter in the tradition of IrfanView, with a complete, customizable command library.

scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.desktop: QN_ORT_LOCAL=1 npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron build/desktop-app
scripts.desktop:dist: QN_ORT_LOCAL=1 npm run build && node scripts/prepare-desktop.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs
scripts.icons: node resources/gen-icon.mjs && node scripts/gen-android-icons.mjs && node scripts/gen-platform-icons.mjs
